done_when: Workers are told to run only the change's related tests before they stop: forge.toml's fast_test with {base} as the merge base with the default branch, or the test command when the repo has no fast_test; the commit nudge names that same command; CI keeps running the full suite. New and existing repos: every repo gets the instruction from the new release's brief and its next forge sync; a repo without fast_test behaves as today. One command-level test: the commit nudge in a repo with fast_test names the fast command with the base filled in.

findings.body: The nudge now selects Forge's `fast_test`, but still tells the worker to test before committing. In this repository, `forge.toml:7` selects `scripts/fast-test.py`, whose lines 10–13 inspect only `git diff <base> HEAD`. On a first round where the worker leaves its source and tests uncommitted, that diff contains only Forge's bookkeeping commits, so lines 25–27 report no related tests and exit successfully. Later rounds likewise omit newly changed modules and tests. This affects both adapters' commit nudges and continued workers that test before committing. Make the configured selector include working-tree, staged and new files, or ensure changes are committed before running a selector that requires committed changes. The new evidence is the selector's committed-only contract; the coordinator's ruling about testing this repair round does not address it.
findings.title: [P1] Make the fast command include uncommitted changes before testing

findings.body: The `config["test"]` guard suppresses command selection when a repository defines `fast_test` but omits or empties `test`. This configuration is accepted: `src/forge/repo.py:136` defaults `test` to an empty string, and its validation at lines 301–319 imposes no dependency between the two settings. Continued rounds correctly resolve `fast_test` through `review.close_test`, but the commit nudge then names no command. Resolve the local command unconditionally and retain the existing empty-result handling.
findings.title: [P2] Select fast_test even when the full test command is empty

why: Every worker round runs the repo's whole test suite on the developer's machine before finishing, about 15-20 minutes of each 30-minute round, though CI runs the same full suite again
